desc: Butterfly queen spirit: flowing lavender gown with gold star hem, three layers of huge butterfly wings per side with gold star patterns, tall gold star crown, floating star orbs beside its hands. Chibi 16-bit pixel art character sprite, big head, small body, right-facing 3/4, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise, no glow, no halo, no shadow. Black void face with small eyes. Palette lavender, white, violet, gold.
